lede.zh: 从真值表出发，把一句话接成一块电路，再用搭出的门搭更大的句子。
lede.en: Start from truth tables: wire a sentence as a circuit, then build bigger sentences from the gates you made.

desc.zh: a ∨ b：至少一个输入是真，就输出真。
desc.en: a ∨ b: outputs true when at least one input is true.

question.zh: 一句话在每一种情况下是真是假，能交给电路去算吗？
question.en: Can a circuit work out whether a sentence is true in every case?
